text: Data about a project, however true, is a pile of lines until someone can look at it and understand.

heading: Pictures made for insiders
text: Most pictures of projects are drawn for the people already inside them: charts of whatever was easy to count, in words you must already know. Each project draws itself its own way - and, naturally, in its best light.

heading: One eye for every project
text:
ocoeco-engine takes what projects say about themselves and draws it the same way for all of them: a page that shows why a project exists, what it must reach, how each step is delivered and proven, and what is happening now.

No project designs its own page. None can look better than its evidence.

heading: Like the legend of a map
text: On a good map a river is always the same blue and a road always the same line. Learn the legend once, and you can read any country.

heading: Plain pages, anyone's lens, any language
text: It makes plain web pages: no scripts, nothing that tracks you, readable on a phone or on paper. A family of projects is seen through a lens, which anyone may declare as one small file. And every word of the interface lives in a catalog, so the same site exists in each language.

heading: What it cannot do
text: It draws what it is given, and no more. It knows only a few kinds of view. And it is redrawn every few hours, not the moment something changes.

heading: Where it stands
text: Running: it draws this site in English and Russian - every project's essence, and three grand views.
